run_ZImageOmniPipeline_call: run the ZImageOmniPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt with optional condition images
create_ZImageOmniPipeline_init: create a ZImageOmniPipeline instance with scheduler, vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, transformer, siglip, and siglip_processor modules
run_ZImageOmniPipeline_encode_prompt: run the ZImageOmniPipeline encode_prompt method to encode text prompts into embeddings with optional negative prompts and classifier-free guidance
run_ZImageOmniPipeline_prepare_image_lat: run the ZImageOmniPipeline prepare_image_latents method to encode condition images into latent representations via the VAE
run_ZImageOmniPipeline_prepare_siglip_em: run the ZImageOmniPipeline prepare_siglip_embeds method to extract SigLIP2 vision embeddings from condition images
